situation (example wording): "Show carjacking trend by month/year", "How many murders stem from arguments", "murder victims killed by shotgun by year from 2020-2024", "Where do most robberies occur - residences, streets, or commercial buildings?"
what the app does today: Said it did not understand "/year", "stem", "killed by" or "where do ... occur".
proposed behavior: One-word synonyms of what is already read: "by month/year" is by month; "stems from" is "from" (a murder's circumstance); "killed by (with, using) a <weapon>" is the weapon (never "killed by police" or by a citizen, which are justifiable homicides); "where do (most) <crime> occur" is the crime by location, a list of places after it (residences, streets, commercial buildings) being the location categories themselves. Each is said in the reading note as the words taken.
exact default or choices offered: The answer to the question as read.
why: Jeff 2026-11-22 (through the coordinator): the one-word synonym batch from the reader failures of the defaults gate (PR 284).
